page.title: Android
page.p: It is recommended to install RECOIL for Android from Google Play. Alternatively, you can download and install it manually.

In the app, simply select the file to view. Both local and cloud storage are supported. The images that consist of multiple files must be stored in a ZIP archive. Also, it's possible to browse multiple images directly from a ZIP archive - select the ZIP file and swipe between the images it contains.
The images can be shared in IM apps, email and social media as standard PNG bitmaps. You can also convert images to PNG files.
